properties.name: A0912/26 / LWSS
properties.originalText:
UKRAINIAN CRISIS - ALL RUSSIAN REGISTERED AIRCRAFT AND AIRCRAFT 
OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS FROM 
THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR BY OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR 
CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES 
ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY THE REPUBLIC OF NORTH 
MACEDONIA AIRSPACE EXCEPT HUMANITARIAN,SAR AND LEASED AIRCRAFT 
ONE-WAY RETURN FLIGHTS WITH THE PERMISSION OF THE APPROPRIATE 
REPUBLIC OF NORTH MACEDONIA AUTHORITIES AND IN CASE OF 
EMERGENCY LANDING OR EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT.
